changelog: 2 from M2-S12's first balance pass (DL-35).
3 from M3's wage for Levels (DL-36).
4 twice over, on two lines at once, from M3's Rival reserve (DL-41) and from M4-S2's Quest Engine (DL-42).
5 twice over again, from merging those two (DL-47) and from M3's infirmary factor for its third grade (DL-53).
6 from merging those, so that no save made under either 5 reads as current (DL-55).
7 from merging that main line with M5's Items, whose new fields' defaults were made under 4 (DL-61).
8 from the M5 close's Loot threshold (DL-62).
5, on a parallel branch, from M6-S1, which moved the Rivals' two thresholds into their Dispositions' rows (DL-56).
9 from merging the main line's 8 with that 5, so that no save made under either reads as current (DL-63).
10 from the M6 close's Transfer lock of a season (DL-69).
11 from M9-S2's Trait budget, `guildmasterTraitBudget` (DL-102).
12 from M9-F1's Guildmasters, 21 to 50 at the start and retiring at 61 (DL-113, DL-114).

13 from v1.1.4-S2's Degrees, `checkDegrees` and `strongTriumphShare` (DL-148, DL-152), which v1.1.4's later stories add their fields under before the release: S11's `guildmasterStatPoints` (DL-149, DL-153), S3's `moraleCheckFactor` and `hurtCheckFactor` (DL-148, DL-154), S4's `exposureRange` and `guardRange` (DL-148, DL-155), S5's `chanceBands` (DL-148, DL-156), S6's `playerPartyMargin` (DL-148, DL-157), and S8's `encounterTagWeight` (DL-148, DL-160). S10's balance pass changes defaults under it too, `checkVariance` 0.2 to 0.4 first (DL-165), then the Degrees, `strongTriumphShare` and the form factors (DL-166), as no game has been released under 13.
14 from v1.1.6-S7, whose config lost `schemaVersion`, `configVersion` and `gearSlots`, every other default as it was (DL-193).
15 from v1.1.6-S16, which adds `heroSexWeights` and `lootOnFinaleDegrees`, at the draw and the rule they had before (DL-202).
16 from v1.1.6-S18, which moves the defaults' values into this file, `engine/src/config.json`, in sections, every value as it was (DL-204).
17 from v1.1.7-S2, which adds `guildmasterSexWeights`, at 1 and 1 the draw it had before (DL-206, DL-208).

18 from v1.2.0-S4, which replaces `boardSize` with `boardSizeStart`, `boardGrowthPerYear` and `boardSizeMax`, at 6, 0 and 6 the Board of six it was, and adds `foundingFame`, at 0 the Fame every Guild was founded with (DL-257 item 4, #40, DL-261).

19 from v1.2.0-S5, which adds the Tier ladder, `tiers`, with `levelsPerTier` and `tierDrawWeights` in a `questTiers` section, each Tier's reward and XP factors neutral a Party-Day against v1.1.9, and removes `lootDifficultyThreshold`, a Tier's `loot` in its place (DL-257 items 1 and 3, #22, DL-262).
20 from v1.2.0-S7, which adds `deathFactor`, at 1, and makes each Tier's `deathScale` read: an Encounter's Death chance is times both, so Tiers 1 to 3 kill no one (DL-257 item 5, DL-265).

21 from v1.2.0-S14, which unlocks the Board's Tiers by each Guild's best four: it adds each Tier's `unlockLevel`, at 0, 3, 6, 9 and 12 the thresholds `levelsPerTier` 3 gave, and `unlockHeroes`, at 4, and removes `levelsPerTier`; `tierDrawWeights` now weighs a Tier by its distance below the Board's top Tier, the last held (DL-271).

22 from v1.2.1-S2, which adds Fatigue in a `fatigue` section: `fatigueMax`, 100, the scale from 0; `fatigueBands`, fresh 0, weary 25, tired 50 and exhausted 75; `fatigueRiseByTier`, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 a night away by Tier; and `fatigueFallByQuarters`, 5, 6, 7 and 8 a night at home by quarters grade (DL-280 item 2, DL-282).

23 from v1.2.1-S3, which makes Morale's form a line, 1 + (m − `moraleBaseline`) ÷ (2 × (`moraleMax` − `moraleMin`)), and removes `moraleCheckFactor`, the band factors it replaces (DL-280 item 3, DL-283).
